compute_box_iou: compute the IoU or IOS overlap metric between two bounding boxes
compute_box_iou_batch: compute pairwise IoU matrix between batches of ground truth and detection bounding boxes
perform_mask_non_max_suppression: perform non-maximum suppression on segmentation predictions to filter overlapping masks
perform_mask_non_max_merge: perform non-maximum merging on segmentation predictions to group overlapping masks
perform_box_non_max_suppression: perform non-maximum suppression on bounding box detection predictions to filter overlaps
